engine_only.DELETE /api/agent-tasks/{id}: Scheduled agent tasks. Writes need `agent-tasks-write`, which is arbitrary code execution and is deliberately not held by the core's engine credential, and answering a task's gate is the only path that approves it. Putting them on MCP is an operator decision about that credential, tracked as WI-1095; until then agents start sessions.
engine_only.DELETE /api/history/{id}: Deleting archived session history. The archive is the record of what sessions — agents included — did, so erasing it is a person's call, and `history-write` is deliberately not held by the core's engine credential.
engine_only.GET /: Routing fallbacks: the `/api` namespace's 404 and the embedded PWA's assets. Not operations.
engine_only.GET /api/agent-auth/git-credential: session-local credential fetch; the MCP counterpart is session.grant_request
engine_only.GET /api/agent-auth/grants: A session's own calls with its per-session broker token (secret fetch/store, launch report, its conversation, its project-policy check, its grants), or the engine-side record of the conversation a session runs. Made by the session's launcher and hooks, not by a person or another agent.
engine_only.GET /api/agent-auth/sessions/{id}/agent: The engine's relay for an outbound pod agent: `bootstrap` mints the per-session stream token and the `/sessions/{id}/agent` socket carries that agent's output frames. Agent plumbing rather than an operation a person or another agent performs; the session's own view of it is `session.screen`.
engine_only.GET /api/agent-auth/sessions/{id}/worksp: A session pod's own containers, not a person or another agent: its init container fetches the installed guidance tree it will work from (WI-4127), its session agent writes back project memory, and before the pod goes — an explicit stop or a hibernation — that agent uploads its uncommitted work as a salvage (WI-3371, WI-4132). Each presents the per-pod bootstrap credential or the per-session stream token its pod holds (the engine withholds its own bearer from sessions), and carries only that pod's files. An agent's equivalent is the session it runs in: its workspace, and `session.commit_for` for work it means to keep.
engine_only.GET /api/agent-tasks: Scheduled agent tasks.
